data.notes: August 2026 is unusually strong for London outdoor music, led by Victoria Park, Crystal Palace Bowl, Greenwich’s Old Royal Naval College, Gunnersbury Park and Wembley Stadium programming.

events.title: All Points East 2026
events.summary: All Points East returns to Victoria Park with major headline days including Jorja Smith + Tems, Lorde, Outbreak Fest with Deftones, two Tyler, The Creator days and Twenty One Pilots.

events.title: The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour
events.summary: The Weeknd plays a five-date Wembley Stadium run on August 14, 15, 16, 18 and 19 as part of the After Hours Til Dawn tour.

events.title: Roots Picnic London
events.summary: Roots Picnic stages its first international edition at Crystal Palace Bowl, running across Saturday 8 and Sunday 9 August.

events.title: Peggy Gou on the Thames
events.summary: Labyrinth presents Peggy Gou at the Old Royal Naval College, with Prospa, Kelly Lee Owens and MPH also listed on the lineup.

events.title: RALLY 2026
events.summary: RALLY returns to Southwark Park with Blood Orange, Daniel Avery live, Smerz, Optimo, Voice Actor, Roman Flügel and more on the announced programme.

events.title: Michael Bibi on the Thames
events.summary: Michael Bibi plays a London 2026 exclusive extended set at the Old Royal Naval College as part of Labyrinth on the Thames.

events.title: Lenny Kravitz Live 2026
events.summary: Lenny Kravitz plays an open-air Gunnersbury Park show with special guests Leon Thomas, Joss Stone, Brooke Combe and De’Wayne.

events.title: Boiler Room: London — Saturday
events.summary: Boiler Room’s Saturday London edition, featuring Face 2 Face and Teletech-hosted stages and a full-day cross-section of rap, underground electronic and techno-adjacent club culture.

events.title: Davido & Friends
events.summary: Davido headlines Crystal Palace Bowl with Omah Lay, Black Sherif, Gabzy, T x C, Jazzwrld & Thukuthela, Ecool, Morravey and Boi Chase listed as guests.

events.title: Jazz Cafe Festival 2026: Ari Lennox
events.summary: Jazz Cafe Festival returns to Burgess Park with Ari Lennox listed as a lead draw, plus Greentea Peng, Smino and more on the DICE lineup listing.

events.title: Signal Festival 2026
events.summary: Signal Festival returns to The Cause with a drum & bass, jungle and dubstep lineup including Goldie, Dillinja, DJ Storm, Doc Scott, Coki, Loefah, Photek, Break and many more.

events.title: Overmono present Pure Devotion
events.summary: Overmono curate a Labyrinth on the Thames date at the Old Royal Naval College, joined by Erika de Casier, Nick León b2b Verraco, Loukeman, Carista and Leod.

events.title: Anjunadeep Open Air on the Thames
events.summary: Anjunadeep Open Air returns to the Old Royal Naval College for a Labyrinth-presented afternoon and evening event, with Marsh, Catching Flies and James Grant among the listed artists.

events.title: 15 years: The Soulection Experience
events.summary: Soulection celebrates 15 years with its biggest UK showcase, bringing the LA-born global collective’s borderless blend of future R&B, soul, hip-hop and electronic sounds to Magazine Open–Air.

events.title: Ghana Party in the Park 2026 Presents ShattaFest UK
events.summary: A large Ghanaian diaspora culture and music gathering with Afrobeats, hip-hop, R&B and reggae, plus food, fashion, masquerade parade, cultural dancers and community programming.

events.title: 4am Kru present RATFEST
events.summary: A Sunday daytime blowout curated by 4am Kru at The Cause, pairing the live-rave energy of 4am Kru with Tim Reaper, Decibella, Singularity UK and a broader UK hardcore/jungle-leaning bill.

events.title: Juls presents A Perfect Summer: Caribbean Nights / Jazz Cafe Residency
events.summary: British-Ghanaian producer and DJ Juls leads a run of late-summer Friday sessions celebrating Black club music, moving through Afrobeats, Amapiano, Afro-Latin and Caribbean sounds.

events.title: UNFOLD CXXVIII
events.summary: FOLD’s cult Sunday techno session returns for an August edition, with the lineup still unannounced but the recurring UNFOLD format firmly central to London’s queer-inclusive hard techno scene.

events.title: Phonox x Jumbi: CIRCULATE with Derrick Carter, Shy One, Jitwam — Day & Night
events.summary: A day-into-night Brixton link-up: Jumbi hosts Shy One, Jitwam and a special guest in the daytime before Phonox hands the booth to Chicago house cornerstone Derrick Carter all night long.

events.title: Touching Bass Carni Jam 2026
events.summary: Touching Bass marks ten years with a pre–Notting Hill Carnival, all-ages Brixton gathering focused on the soundsystem continuum, Afro-Caribbean spirit, food, dance and community.
